title: cellSize
body:
## cellSize

Adds cell-data arrays holding the size of each cell: Length for 1-D cells (lines, polylines), Area for 2-D cells (triangles, quads, polygons) and Volume for 3-D cells, all in dataset coordinate units (length, length squared, length cubed). Cells of a dimension that is not computed get 0 in that array. Use it for cell volumes or face areas, e.g. to weight cell values or check mesh resolution; with sum enabled the totals are also stored as field data. pvCellSize exposes the same filter with every native setting, including the vertex count and array names; pvMeshQuality rates cell shape instead of size.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Each array is filled for every cell, so a mixed mesh shows 0 in Volume for its faces and 0 in Area for its volume cells; filter by cell type before taking statistics.
- Polygon areas are computed by a fan triangulation that is exact only for convex planar polygons.

Native constructor: `CellSize`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Cell Size filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); composite data (multiblock or partitioned collections) (vtkCompositeDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkCompositeDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `area` | Specify whether or not to compute the area of 2D cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `volume` | Specify whether or not to compute the volume of 3D cells . | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `length` | Specify whether or not to compute the length of 1D cells. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |
| `sum` | Specify whether or not to sum the computed sizes of cells in datasets. The result is stored in field data. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "cellSize",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
